question: __________ is swim on the back in swimming.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Backstroke**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Backstroke** is one of the four main swimming styles used in competitive swimming.
 
• It involves swimmers lying on their backs and using an alternating arm stroke and a flutter kick.
 
• The backstroke is unique because it is the only stroke that is swum on the back, providing a different breathing pattern compared to other strokes.
 
• It is also known for being a relatively fast stroke, second only to the freestyle in terms of speed.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Streamline**

 
 
• Streamline is a technique used in swimming to reduce drag and improve speed.
 
• It involves the swimmer positioning their body in a straight line, with arms extended above the head, hands together, and body tight.
 
• This position is often used at the start of a race or after a turn to maximize speed before beginning the stroke.
 
 
 
• **Butterfly Stroke**
 
 
• The butterfly stroke is another competitive swimming stroke, known for its demanding technique and high energy consumption.
 
• It involves a simultaneous arm movement and a dolphin kick, where both legs move together in a wave-like motion.
 
• This stroke is considered one of the most challenging due to the coordination and strength required.
 
 
 
• **Freestyle**
 
 
• Freestyle is the fastest and most popular swimming stroke in competitive swimming.
 
• Swimmers use an alternating arm stroke and a flutter kick, similar to the backstroke but performed on the stomach.
 
• There are no specific rules on how to swim freestyle, which allows swimmers to use any technique they find fastest, although the front crawl is most commonly used.
